verdict.rationale: Replit describes a design space where you can "explore and tweak designs visually" and apply them to your app, and its docs mention iterating on layouts and components and working from a selected frame in Replit Design. That points toward visual editing, but nothing documents selecting an individual element and directly editing its text, style or layout without prompting Agent; the frame-selection example still hands the work to Agent via a prompt. missing for 10: explicit select-element direct editing of text, style and layout, documentation that edits skip the Agent prompt round-trip, hands-on or independent corroboration.
